page_title: DEN 0-0 TUN | Denmark v Tunisia 22/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Mikkel Damsgaard (Denmark) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle for a foul.

90+7' Andreas Cornelius (Denmark) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
90+7' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) prepares to take a corner kick.
90+6' Joakim Maehle (Denmark) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+4' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Denmark as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

90+4' There's a break in play and referee Cesar Arturo Ramos must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Denmark using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+3' The attendance is 42925.
90+3' Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Aymen Dahmen was alert and made a comfortable save.
90+3' Surely that's handball by one of the Tunisia players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+3' The corner from Christian Eriksen (Denmark) is hurriedly cleared.
90+2' Joakim Maehle (Denmark) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Denmark will take a corner kick.
90+1' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Jalel Kadri has decided to make a change. Ferjani Sassi (Tunisia) replaces Aissa Laidouni.
88' Substitution. Wajdi Kechrida (Tunisia) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mohamed Drager walks off.
87' Mohamed Drager (Tunisia) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Taha Yassine Khenissi (Tunisia) was quite harsh and Cesar Arturo Ramos didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
84' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 60:40.
80' Here is a change. Issam Jebali is going off and Jalel Kadri gives the last tactical orders to Taha Yassine Khenissi (Tunisia).
80' Youssef Msakni goes off the pitch and Hannibal Mejbri (Tunisia) comes on.
78' The game has begun to heat up. Mathias Jensen (Denmark) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
76' Mathias Jensen (Denmark) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:13.
71' Naim Sliti (Tunisia) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
71' Joakim Maehle (Denmark) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
71' Andreas Cornelius (Denmark) with a powerful header hits the post.
70' Corner kick. Christian Eriksen (Denmark) is ready to send the ball into the box.

69' Aymen Dahmen makes a brilliant save! Christian Eriksen (Denmark) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the right side of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
67' The manager makes a subsitution with Naim Sliti (Tunisia) coming on for Anis Slimane.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jesper Lindstrom (Denmark) comes onto the pitch so that Andreas Skov Olsen can be given a rest.
65' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to substitute Kasper Dolberg and he is replaced by Andreas Cornelius (Denmark).
65' Substitution. Simon Kjaer makes his way off the pitch and Mathias Jensen (Denmark) comes on as his replacement.
61' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
61' Andreas Skov Olsen (Denmark) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Denmark will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
60' Joachim Andersen (Denmark) commits a rough challenge and Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle for an infringement.
57' Kasper Dolberg (Denmark) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
56' Mikkel Damsgaard (Denmark) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
53' The resulting corner from Anis Slimane (Tunisia) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
53' Dylan Bronn (Tunisia) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Tunisia can continue in their attacking effort.
52' Anis Slimane (Tunisia) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
52' A dangerous looking corner kick from Anis Slimane (Tunisia) is cleared to safety by the defence.
52' Mohamed Drager (Tunisia) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Tunisia win a corner kick.
51' Tunisia take a short corner kick.

51' Aissa Laidouni (Tunisia) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Tunisia have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
51' Rasmus Kristensen (Denmark) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
49' Cesar Arturo Ramos blows for a foul after Joakim Maehle (Denmark) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
46' Youssef Msakni (Tunisia) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
46' Ali Abdi (Tunisia) is about to take a corner kick.
46' Mohamed Drager (Tunisia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Tunisia.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
45+5' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
45+4' Denmark have a free kick.
45+3' Issam Jebali (Tunisia) makes a strong challenge and Cesar Arturo Ramos blows for a foul.
45+1' Problems for Kasper Hjulmand as Thomas Delaney is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Mikkel Damsgaard (Denmark) replaces him.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Thomas Delaney (Denmark) picks up an injury.
43' Tunisia fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
43' Issam Jebali (Tunisia) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Kasper Schmeichel.
42' PENALTY APPEAL after Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Denmark) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
41' Andreas Skov Olsen (Denmark) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
39' Aissa Laidouni (Tunisia) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the right post.
38' Anis Slimane (Tunisia) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
38' Andreas Skov Olsen (Denmark) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
36' Joakim Maehle (Denmark) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
35' Joachim Andersen (Denmark) sends a long ball in, but Aymen Dahmen comfortably gathers the ball.
35' Denmark seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
34' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Denmark) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

34' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Denmark) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Aymen Dahmen!
33' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
33' An attempted cross from Andreas Skov Olsen (Denmark) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Denmark.
32' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) takes the corner which is cleared.
31' Simon Kjaer (Denmark) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked. Denmark have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Yassine Meriah (Tunisia) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Rasmus Kristensen (Denmark) sends a cross into the box, but Aymen Dahmen comes off his line to gather the ball.
27' A cross by Thomas Delaney (Denmark) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
24' Cesar Arturo Ramos shows a yellow card to Rasmus Kristensen (Denmark) for his blatant foul.
24' Issam Jebali (Tunisia) has a goal ruled out for offside!
23' Joachim Andersen (Denmark) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot goalwards, but Aymen Dahmen gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
22' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
21' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
21' Joachim Andersen (Denmark) outbattles his marker to get a close-range header in on goal from the corner, but a defender unwittingly blocks the ball as it looked set to find the net.
21' Christian Eriksen (Denmark) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
20' Joakim Maehle (Denmark) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
16' Rasmus Kristensen (Denmark) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
12' Youssef Msakni (Tunisia) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
12' Anis Slimane (Tunisia) will take the corner.
11' Mohamed Drager (Tunisia) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Good work from Tunisia as they win a corner.
8' Dangerous play by Joachim Andersen (Denmark). Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Denmark.
3' Youssef Msakni (Tunisia) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
1' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Christian Eriksen (Denmark), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
